summary: Designer Brands Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its Board approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share on Class A and Class B common shares, payable July 8, 2026, to holders of record June 25, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend declaration, not a substantive corporate event. No special-situation category applies. The role of the registrant is issuer. The filing lacks terms typical of special situations such as acquisitions, activism, restructuring, or capital returns events beyond ordinary dividends. Accordingly, this is not a special situation filing.
